SD23-014.effect:

[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't attack/block, loses all its effects, and can't gain new ones. That Spirit is treated as a Spirit with no printed effects.

SD23-016.name: Reversal Force

[Flash]

[Flash]
